paite: Kanaan gam a galdou kha nai het lou Israelte etchetna ding in TOUPA'N hiai namte anusia hi.
heading: Gamsung A Om Lai Namte
english: Now these are the nations which Yahweh left, to test Israel by them, even as many as had not known all the wars of Canaan;

paite: Atup bel Israel suante, tuma a galdoudan thei nai hetloute galdoudan sinsak ahihna ding lel ahi.
english: only that the generations of the children of Israel might know, to teach them war, at least those who knew nothing of it before:

paite: Huaite bel: Philistiate kumpipa ngate, Kanaan mi tengte, Sidonte leh Lebanon tang a teng Hivte ahi ua, Baal-hermon tang a pan Hamath lutna pha in ahi uh.
english: the five lords of the Philistines, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites who lived on Mount Lebanon, from Mount Baal Hermon to the entrance of Hamath.

paite: TOUPA'N Mosi zang a apipute uh thu ana piakte azuih ding uh leh zuih louh ding uh theihna ding in, huaite Israelte chetna ding ahi uh.
english: They were left to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to Yahweh’s commandments, which he commanded their fathers by Moses.

paite: Israel suante Kanaante, Hitte, Amorte, Perizte, Hivte leh Jebuste lak ah ateng uhi.
english: The children of Israel lived among the Canaanites, the Hittites, the Amorites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites.

paite: Atanute uh zi in anei ua, atanute uh atapate uh zi in apia ua, apathiante uh nna asem uhi.
english: They took their daughters to be their wives, and gave their own daughters to their sons and served their gods.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih ua, TOUPA a Pathian uh amangngilh ua, Baal leh Astoreth nna asem uhi.
heading: Othniel
english: The children of Israel did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and forgot Yahweh their God, and served the Baals and the Asheroth.

paite: Huchi in TOUPA Israelte tung ah ahehta a, Mesopo Mesopotamia gam kumpipa Kushan-risathaim kiang ah azuakta hi. Huchi in Israel suante'n Kushan-risathaim nna kum giat asem uhi.
english: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia; and the children of Israel served Cushan Rishathaim eight years.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Israel suante hunkhepa abawlsak a, huai mi in amau ahunkheta hi. Huai mi bel Kaleb naupa Kenaz tapa Othniel ahi.
english: When the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior to the children of Israel, who saved them, even Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother.

paite: TOUPA kha atung ah ahong tung a, Israel tung ah vai ahawm hi. Ama'n Mesopotamia gam kumpipa Kushan-risathaim ava dou a, TOUPA'N Kushan-risathaim a khut ah apia a, azouta hi.
english: Yahweh’s Spirit came on him, and he judged Israel; and he went out to war, and Yahweh delivered Cushan Rishathaim king of Mesopotamia into his hand. His hand prevailed against Cushan Rishathaim.

paite: Huchi in kum sawmli gam galmuang in a-omta a, huchi in Kenaz tapa Othniel asita hi.
english: The land had rest forty years, then Othniel the son of Kenaz died.

paite: Israel suante'n TOUPA mitmuh in thil gilou ahih nawn uh. TOUPA mitmuh a thil ahihkhelh ziak un TOUPA'N Israelte tung ah Moab kumpipa Eglon ahatsak hi.
heading: Ehud
english: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight, and Yahweh strengthened Eglon the king of Moab against Israel, because they had done that which was evil in Yahweh’s sight.

paite: Ama'n Ammon leh Amalek suante akaikhawm a; Israelte ava dou a, tum sing khopi aluahta hi.
english: He gathered the children of Ammon and Amalek to himself; and he went and struck Israel, and they possessed the city of palm trees.

paite: Huchi in Moab kumpipa Eglon thunuai ah Israelte kum sawm-le-giat a-om uhi.
english: The children of Israel served Eglon the king of Moab eighteen years.

paite: Himahleh Israel suante'n TOUPA asaptak un, TOUPA'N Gera tapa Ehud, Benjamin mi, miveilong, hunkhepa abawlsak hi. Israel suante'n Moab kumpipa piak ding kipahman Ehud atawisak uhi.
english: But when the children of Israel cried to Yahweh, Yahweh raised up a savior for them: Ehud the son of Gera, the Benjamite, a left-handed man. The children of Israel sent tribute by him to Eglon the king of Moab.

paite: Ehud in namsau hiamtuah tongtan a sau in asek a; puan nuai ah ataklam pheipi ah ahenbelh hi.
english: Ehud made himself a sword which had two edges, a cubit in length; and he wore it under his clothing on his right thigh.

paite: Moab kumpipa Eglon kipahman ava pia a; Eglon bel mithautak ahi.
english: He offered the tribute to Eglon king of Moab. Now Eglon was a very fat man.

paite: Kipahman ava piak khit in, kipahman tawite apaisak nawn hi.
english: When Ehud had finished offering the tribute, he sent away the people who carried the tribute.

paite: Amah bel Gilgal kho kiang a suangsekna mun a pan anungkik nawn a, "I aw, kumpipa, hon hilh ding thuguk ka nei hi," achi hi. Ama'n, "Dai un," achi hi. Huchi in akiang a dingh teng in apawtkhiaksan vek uhi.
english: But he himself turned back from the stone idols that were by Gilgal, and said, “I have a secret message for you, O king.” The king said, “Keep silence!” All who stood by him left him.

paite: Ehud in akiang ava naih a; amah bel anipi dantan ah amah kia in ana tu hi. Ehud in, "Pathian in na kiang a gen ding thu ahon thukhak hi," achi hi. Atutphah a kipan amah hong dingh hi.
english: Ehud came to him; and he was sitting by himself alone in the cool upper room. Ehud said, “I have a message from God to you.” He arose out of his seat.

paite: Ehud in akhut veilam in apheipi taklam a namsau adokkhia a, agil ah adawt hi.
english: Ehud put out his left hand, and took the sword from his right thigh, and thrust it into his body.

paite: Anamsau bul tan in atum a, athau in namsau ahubit a, agilpi a pan namsau adokkhe kei a, a-ek atolhkhia hi.
english: The handle also went in after the blade; and the fat closed on the blade, for he didn’t draw the sword out of his body; and it came out behind.

paite: Huchi in Ehud inlim ah apawt a, dantan kongkhakte akhakkhum a, akalh bikbek hi.
english: Then Ehud went out onto the porch, and shut the doors of the upper room on him, and locked them.

paite: Apawt khit nung in, asikhate ahong pai ua, ava ettak un ngai in, dantan kongkhakte ana kikalh hi. "Anipi dantan ah atuam om tadih a hi in teh," achi uhi.
english: After he had gone, his servants came and saw that the doors of the upper room were locked. They said, “Surely he is covering his feet in the upper room.”

paite: Zumhuai tan khop in angak nilouh ua, ngai in, dantan kongkhakte ahong himhim kei a; huchi in chabi ala ua, ahong ua; ngai in, akumpipa uh pialkhang ah sisa in ana puk hi.
english: They waited until they were ashamed; and behold, he didn’t open the doors of the upper room. Therefore they took the key and opened them, and behold, their lord had fallen down dead on the floor.

paite: Ehud lah huchi a angak nilouh sung un ana taimang khin a, huai suangsekna mun akheng a, Seirah ah atailut hi.
english: Ehud escaped while they waited, passed beyond the stone idols, and escaped to Seirah.

paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai mun atun in Ephraim tanggam ah pengkul amut a, Israel suante tanggam a pan akiang ah apaisuk ua, ama'n ama uh akaita hi.
english: When he had come, he blew a trumpet in the hill country of Ephraim; and the children of Israel went down with him from the hill country, and he led them.

paite: Ama'n akiang uah, "Hon zui dih ua. TOUPA'N na melma uh Moabte hon pe khinta ahi,” achi hi. Huchi in azuisuk ua, Moab gam chin Jordan lui kannate ala ua; kuamah agalkah uh aphal kei hi.
english: He said to them, “Follow me; for Yahweh has delivered your enemies the Moabites into your hand.” They followed him, and took the fords of the Jordan against the Moabites, and didn’t allow any man to pass over.

paite: Huai hun in Moabte mihat ngen taleh mihat hangsan hoih ngenta singkhat athat ua; khat lel leng taikhia a-om kei uh.
english: They struck at that time about ten thousand men of Moab, every strong man and every man of valor. No man escaped.

paite: Huchi in huai ni in Israelte lak ah Moabte azahlak uhi. Huchi in gam kum sawmgiat sung galmuang in a-om hi.
english: So Moab was subdued that day under the hand of Israel. Then the land had rest eighty years.

paite: Anung in Anath tapa Shamgar ahong kilang a, huai mi'n bawng sutna chiang in Philistiate zaguk asunlum a; Israelte ahunkhia hi.
heading: Shamgar
english: After him was Shamgar the son of Anath, who struck six hundred men of the Philistines with an ox goad. He also saved Israel.
